definitions.explanation: A dining arrangement where customers can serve themselves as much food as they want, typically at a buffet or salad bar.

examples.japanese: サラダバーは{盛|も}り{放題|ほうだい}です。
ごはんの{盛|も}り{放題|ほうだい}サービスがある。
examples.english: There's an unlimited rice serving service.

examples.japanese: このカレー{屋|や}さんはライスとサラダが{盛|も}り{放題|ほうだい}なので、{学生|がくせい}に{人気|にんき}がある。
examples.english: This curry restaurant offers unlimited rice and salad, so it's popular with students.

notes:
A compound of {盛|も}る (to heap, to serve food onto a plate) and {放題|ほうだい} (as much as one likes). The 〜{放題|ほうだい} suffix attaches to verb stems to create "all-you-can-X" expressions. This one specifically refers to food you serve yourself in unlimited quantities.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ごはん{盛|も}り{放題|ほうだい}: unlimited rice servings
- サラダ{盛|も}り{放題|ほうだい}: all-you-can-serve salad
- {盛|も}り{放題|ほうだい}サービス: unlimited serving service

RELATED 〜{放題|ほうだい} EXPRESSIONS:
- {食|た}べ{放題|ほうだい}: all-you-can-eat
- {飲|の}み{放題|ほうだい}: all-you-can-drink
- {取|と}り{放題|ほうだい}: take as much as you want
- {言|い}いたい{放題|ほうだい}: saying whatever one pleases
